#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

struct TaskC {
    static const int shift = 15;
    static const int maxn = 60;
    static const int INF = INT_MAX;
    string d;
    vector<int> memo;
    int len;

    void solve() {
        string s;
        cin >> s;
        d = "000" + s;
        len = d.length();
        int size = (len + 1) * (maxn + 1) * (maxn + 1) * (2 * shift + 1);
        memo.assign(size, -1);
        int ans = dfs(0, maxn, maxn, shift);
        cout << ans << endl;
    }

    inline int idx(int pos, int plus, int minus, int carry) const {
        return ((pos * (maxn + 1) + plus) * (maxn + 1) + minus) * (2 * shift + 1) + carry;
    }

    int dfs(int pos, int plus, int minus, int carry) {
        if (pos == len) {
            return (plus == maxn && minus == maxn && carry == shift) ? 0 : INF;
        }
        int& res = memo[idx(pos, plus, minus, carry)];
        if (res != -1) return res;
        int best = INF;
        if (plus < maxn) best = min(best, dfs(pos, plus + 1, minus, carry));
        if (minus < maxn) best = min(best, dfs(pos, plus, minus + 1, carry));
        int digit = d[pos] - '0';
        int realCarry = carry - shift;
        int curN = plus - minus + realCarry;
        int curD = curN % 10;
        if (curD < 0) curD += 10;
        int newCarry = (curN - curD) / 10;
        if (curD == digit) {
            int nextVal = dfs(pos + 1, plus, minus, newCarry + shift);
            if (nextVal != INF) {
                best = min(best, plus + minus + nextVal);
            }
        }
        res = best;
        return best;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    TaskC solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
